one_line: Daily git-scraped commits of Toronto's official Short Term Rental Registrations CSV from the city open-data portal, live as of 13 Sep 2026; licence 'other'.
abnb_use: A genuinely point-in-time municipal STR-registration panel (each commit a dated vintage) for a top North American market — gaps 4 and 12, and better-vintaged than any of our ~25 held registries.
sample_plan: Pull the current short-term-rental-registrations-data.csv plus 3-4 dated historical versions recovered from the commit history (quarterly spacing) to measure the registered-unit trend; cap 25 MB total, prefer under 10 MB.
